name: Sunless Horizon 1.5
summary:
Somewhere, somewhen, and nowhere in particular, a stellated octahedron fell on a beach. Gifted with the power of free will, you can guide this object through conversations. Skillchecks and all.

An open-world adventure, written by Snek and Ænthroppe, 9.5K words. Made for NOISE JAM 4.
